questions.cardDe: In Italien gilt Freitag der 17. als Unglückstag. Richtig oder falsch?
questions.de: Welcher Freitag gilt in Italien – statt Freitag, dem 13. – als Unglückstag?
questions.en: Which Friday is considered an unlucky day in Italy, instead of Friday the 13th?

timeline.labelEn: Study 'Friday the 17th & Superstition in the Italian Stock Market' published
timeline.labelDe: Studie „Friday the 17th & Superstition in the Italian Stock Market“ erscheint

questions.notes: True on the card. The superstition itself has no datable origin (often explained by XVII being an anagram of VIXI, 'I have lived'); the timeline marks the study the source cites.

timeline.labelDe: Radarstudie misst den Höhenflug von Marienkäfern in Großbritannien

questions.notes: The card's 60 km/h is generous: the 2013 radar study (Jeffries et al., PLOS ONE) cited on the source page measured ladybirds flying at about 30 km/h, up to 120 km and near 1,100 m altitude.
